label: Computer Use 是什么

label: 为什么需要 Computer Use
action: 比较完成退货的两种入口
actionEn: Compare two routes to completing a return
look: 同一目标，两种入口
Two routes to the same goal
say: 目标是给 1048 号订单创建退货记录。上面这条路用 API，也就是给程序调用的接口，直接请求应用完成。下面这条路适用于没有合适 API 的地方：通过界面填表、提交。Computer Use 提供了这种入口，两条路也可以在同一个任务里配合。

The goal is to create a return for order 1048. The upper route uses an API, an interface programs can call directly. The lower route handles work without a suitable API by filling and submitting the form through the interface. Computer Use supplies that route, and a task can combine both.

label: Computer Use 如何工作
action: 连续播放截图、定位、填表和验证
actionEn: Play observation, targeting, form entry and verification
look: 新截图确认退货已创建
A fresh screenshot confirms the return
say: 右边是 context，也就是模型当前能用的信息：目标、截图和操作记录。左边已经标出了订单号输入框。把“要找什么”对应到屏幕位置，叫 UI grounding。 表单已经填好。模型通过 tool call 请求工具输入订单号、选择原因；工具执行后，新截图回到 context。现在确认的是表单填对了，还没有创建退货。 提交后，应用生成了 R-204 回执，新截图也把它带了回来。这才确认目标完成。Agent 就是这样把观察、判断、操作和结果检查接成循环。

The context on the right contains the goal, screenshot and action history available to the model. The order-number field is now marked on the left. Connecting what we want to a position on screen is called UI grounding. The form is now filled. Through tool calls, the model asks tools to enter the order number and choose a reason. A fresh screenshot returns to context. This confirms the fields, but the return has not been created yet. After submission, the app produced receipt R-204, and a fresh screenshot brought it back. Now the goal is confirmed. The agent connects observation, decisions, actions and checks into a loop.

label: Computer Use 如何处理意外

label: 用新观察修正下一步

The fresh screenshot has brought the popup into context, and its Close button is located. The model can now choose an action based on the actual obstruction. label: Computer Use 如何训练
action: 播放多任务练习、反馈与参数更新
actionEn: Play varied practice, feedback and weight updates
look: 训练得到新模型
Training produces an updated model
say: 模型点了 Cancel，表单被关掉，退货没有创建。中间把这个结果记为失败。训练反馈要看任务有没有完成，不能只看有没有点击。 把这样的练习积累起来，训练程序根据反馈反复调整 weights，也就是模型内部学到的参数。OpenAI 的 Computer Use 模型就使用了强化学习，英文是 reinforcement learning。这里把多轮练习和更新缩成一段示意。

The model clicked Cancel, closing the form without creating a return. The middle panel records the outcome as a failure. Training feedback must reflect task completion, rather than a click alone. Across many practice tasks, feedback guides updates to the weights: the model’s learned parameters. OpenAI’s computer-using agent uses reinforcement learning. This diagram condenses many rounds of practice and updates.

label: Jev 是什么
action: 停在术语开场页
actionEn: Hold the chapter opening
look: Jev：面向分类、评分等明确判断
Jev: a model for focused decisions
say: Jev 是 TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，用来处理答案范围清楚的判断。例如：这封邮件该交给哪个部门？我们先看怎样给它出题。
Jev is TypeSafe’s System One model for decisions with a defined answer space. For example, which team should receive an email? Let’s see how to ask it.
transition: 从一封退货邮件开始。
Start with a return email.

label: 认识 Jev
Introducing Jev
end: Jev：面向分类、评分等明确判断
Jev: a model for focused decisions
say: Jev 是 TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，用来处理答案范围清楚的判断。例如：这封邮件该交给哪个部门？我们先看怎样给它出题。
Jev is TypeSafe’s System One model for decisions with a defined answer space. For example, which team should receive an email? Let’s see how to ask it.

label: 谁来定义 Jev 的问题
action: 先问一题，再在同一输入上加一题
actionEn: Ask one question, then add a second over the same input
look: 两题、两个答案；Choice、Score、Noul 是可选题型
Two questions, two answers; Choice, Score and Noul are available types
say: 这封退货邮件就是本次输入，这里叫 state。我们定义问题“交给哪个部门”，再提供退货、账单、物流三个选项。这种题型叫 Choice。Jev 给每个选项一个概率；选项由我们定，判断由模型做。 再加一道题：“客户想退货吗？”Noul 返回“是”的概率。现在两题对应两个答案。下面的 Choice、Score、Noul 是三种题型，Score 用来自定标准打分；它们不是固定三个输出。问题和数量可以随请求改变，不用为每道新题重新训练。

The return email is the input, called state here. We define the question, “Which team?”, and supply returns, billing and shipping as options. This question type is Choice. Jev assigns probabilities; we define the options, and the model makes the judgment. Add “Does the customer want a return?” Noul gives the probability of yes, so two questions now have two answers. Choice, Score and Noul are question types, not three mandatory outputs; Score uses a rating scale we define. Questions and their number can change with each request without retraining for each new question.

label: Decoding：从第一个 token 到完整短句

look: 短句已完成，右侧保留四步 context 变化
The sentence is complete; four steps show how context grew
say: Decoding 就是根据当前 context，一步步选出下一个 token。看刚才的过程：先选 We，把它加进 context，再预测 can，然后是 help 和句号。左边得到完整短句，右边保留每一步用了什么 context。Token 可以是词、字符或文字片段，这里的切分只是示意。

Decoding selects the next token from the current context, one step at a time. We is selected first and added to the context; then come can, help and the period. The finished sentence is on the left, and the history on the right shows how the context grew. A token can be a word, character or text fragment; the divisions here are illustrative.

label: Jev 和 LLM 怎样产生答案
labelEn: How Jev and an LLM produce answers
action: 先看 LLM 逐步生成，再看 Jev 并行输出概率
actionEn: Follow LLM generation, then Jev’s parallel probability outputs
look: 两个独立答案由 API 装进 JSON
The API packages the two independent answers as JSON
say: 回到刚才那封邮件和两道题。左边的 LLM 一次请求就能回答，用 JSON Schema 限定字段和类型。它仍然通过 decoding 顺序生成这份 JSON。画面为了好读，把输出分成了较大的文字片段。 按 TypeSafe 的说明，右边的 Jev 根据同一份 state，并行给出各题的概率，再由 API 包装成 JSON。它省去了把答案逐段写成文字的顺序输出，所以可能降低延迟；具体快多少仍要实测。两边拿到的都是 JSON，产生答案的过程不同。

Return to the same email and two questions. The LLM can answer both in one request, with JSON Schema constraining fields and types. It still decodes the JSON sequentially. We use larger readable chunks for the display. According to TypeSafe, Jev produces each question’s probabilities in parallel from the same state; the API packages them as JSON. Avoiding sequential text output can reduce latency, but the actual gain needs measurement. Both deliver JSON through different output processes.

label: 何时用 Jev，何时保留 LLM
labelEn: When to consider Jev and when an LLM suffices

Jev supplies the judgment; code moves the ticket. We chose 0.90 for this illustration. This customer has two issues: a return and a duplicate charge. The example gives returns 0.61 and billing 0.35. Routing only by the highest label could overlook the other issue. The same rule now sends the ticket to a person. Compare errors and calibration first, then latency and cost, using the same new test tickets.

say: 第二条路线像做题后整理练习材料。STaR 从已有题目和标准答案开始，让模型写解题过程。第一题答对，留下；第二题答成 7，给它答案 10，再试着写出能得到 10 的过程。它生成的是解题过程，题目和判断答案的依据仍由外部提供。 积累很多这样的例子，再做 fine-tuning，微调：用选出的题目和解题过程训练模型，改变 weights。训练后的模型再生成下一批，继续筛选和训练。这比在一次聊天的 context 里记住一句提示多了一步。也要注意，答案碰巧正确不保证过程正确，模型有没有学好还得用新题检查。

The second route resembles collecting useful practice solutions. STaR starts with existing questions and known answers, and asks the model for solution steps. Keep the first correct answer. label: 改训练工具

say: 训练 AI 时，有些小段计算会反复运行，这叫 kernel。可以把一次大计算分成小块，怎样分才更适合硬件，会影响效率。AlphaEvolve 用 Gemini 提出改法，再实际运行，检查答案是否正确、速度是否改善。和排序页一样，不能只听 AI 说它更好。 现在改好的 K 回到 Gemini 的训练里。DeepMind 报告，这类 kernel 平均加速 23%，整体训练时间约减少 1%。因为它反复运行，局部节省也有价值。但这里证明的是训练更省；是否因此得到更会研发的 AI，还要另外检验。

Training repeatedly runs small compute routines called kernels. A large computation can be divided into smaller pieces; how those pieces fit the hardware affects efficiency. AlphaEvolve uses Gemini to propose changes, then runs checks for correctness and speed. As with sorting, a claim of improvement is not enough. The improved K now goes into Gemini training. DeepMind reported an average 23% kernel speedup and about 1% less total training time. Repeated computation makes those savings useful. This establishes more efficient training; better AI research ability needs separate evidence.

end: Gemini 提议的 kernel 改动通过正确性与速度检查
Gemini’s proposed kernel change passes correctness and speed checks
say: 训练 AI 时，有些小段计算会反复运行，这叫 kernel。可以把一次大计算分成小块，怎样分才更适合硬件，会影响效率。AlphaEvolve 用 Gemini 提出改法，再实际运行，检查答案是否正确、速度是否改善。和排序页一样，不能只听 AI 说它更好。

Training repeatedly runs small compute routines called kernels. A large computation can be divided into smaller pieces; how those pieces fit the hardware affects efficiency. AlphaEvolve uses Gemini to propose changes, then runs checks for correctness and speed. As with sorting, a claim of improvement is not enough.

label: 把改进用回 AI 训练
Use the improvement in AI training
end: 同一块 K 移入 Gemini 训练，显示已报告的效率收益
The same K enters Gemini training and the reported efficiency gains appear
say: 现在改好的 K 回到 Gemini 的训练里。DeepMind 报告，这类 kernel 平均加速 23%，整体训练时间约减少 1%。因为它反复运行，局部节省也有价值。但这里证明的是训练更省；是否因此得到更会研发的 AI，还要另外检验。

The improved K now goes into Gemini training. DeepMind reported an average 23% kernel speedup and about 1% less total training time. Repeated computation makes those savings useful. This establishes more efficient training; better AI research ability needs separate evidence.

label: 三条路线与递归
labelEn: Three routes and the recursive step
action: 对照改动位置，再播放条件性的接棒
actionEn: Compare what changes, then play the conditional handoff
look: 条件性回路：v2 回到左侧做改进，右侧出现 v3 问号
Conditional loop: v2 takes over on the left; v3 appears with a question mark
say: 把三种做法并排看：DGM 改工具和流程，STaR 通过训练改 weights，AlphaEvolve 改训练用的程序。这是帮助理解的分法，不是 RSI 只有这三种。它们的共同问题是：改进会不会反馈到下一轮，帮助系统做出后续改进？ 递归发生在这条回来的箭头：上一轮改好的系统，参与下一轮改进。这里的系统既可以是模型，也可以包含工具和流程。要检验它是否真的更会改进，得用新任务和相同预算比较。DGM 展示了有限编程 Agent 的反馈回路；这些例子都不能直接推出 AI 已经能无限自我升级。

Side by side: DGM changes tools and workflows, STaR trains weights, and AlphaEvolve improves training code. These are useful examples, not an exhaustive taxonomy of RSI. The shared question is whether an improvement feeds back and helps the system make later improvements. The return arrow is the recursive step: the improved system participates in the next improvement round. A system can include both a model and its tools and workflow. Compare on new tasks with the same budget to test whether improvement ability grew. DGM demonstrates a bounded coding-agent feedback loop; these examples do not establish unlimited self-improvement.
transition: 回到今天的三个问题：能否操作、能否判断、能否继续改进。

label: 三个概念的比较
action: 回到三章地图及成功依据
actionEn: Return to the chapter map and evidence of success
look: 总结画面
The closing map
say: Computer Use 关心操作有没有完成；Jev 关心判断是否可靠、是否划算；RSI 关心改进后的 AI 能否把下一轮研发做得更好。三个概念都要看实际结果，但需要验证的东西不同。

Computer Use asks whether the action achieved its goal. Jev asks whether a decision is reliable and worth its cost. RSI asks whether the improved AI can make the next round of research better. All three need evidence, but they need evidence of different things.
